schedules.title: Workspace care
schedules.description: Nightly care for this workspace: files durable memory and learnings, keeps the review queue current, and runs the deeper vault index and hygiene audit when its weekly pass is due.
schedules.prompt: Run this workspace's nightly Workspace care. Load and follow the `memory-curation` skill; it is the complete daily procedure and decides from its persisted last-full-pass marker whether the deeper weekly index and hygiene pass is due. Use one memory agent for vault writes and run mutating passes sequentially. If nothing needs processing, reply with the skill's one-line no-op. Otherwise use its plain-language report format, including every cross-project fact still waiting for approval, one numbered line each.

schedules.title: Skill reflection
schedules.description: Weekly reflection on this workspace's user-owned skills: looks for repeated, causally related errors or corrections and keeps one plain-language improvement proposal per skill. Nothing is applied automatically.
schedules.prompt: Run `python3 -m ciao.skill_evolution --workspace "$CIAO_ACTIVE_WORKSPACE" --min-sessions 2` for THIS workspace only, using the workspace default model. Analyze only skills owned in this workspace's canonical `skills/` directory. Keep at most one open proposal per skill, summarize proposals and failed gates in plain language, and apply nothing automatically.
